patronOf.en-US: Patron of pilgrims and of Spain
patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeiro dos peregrinos e da Espanha

prayerExcerpt.en-US: We are able to drink the chalice.

meta.face: A youthful man around 28, chestnut hair falling in soft waves to the jaw, a young light beard that is short and sparse, open eager expression.
meta.basis: Young man with a young beard (Painter's Manual); identity carried by the pilgrim's attributes.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
